lead: Tuesday ended as release night: Anthropic unveiled [Claude Opus 5.5](../summaries/6e142cae15e5.md), its first model since publicly calling for pacing the frontier, and OpenAI answered with [GPT-6 Sol and Luna](../summaries/8375187ae71f.md) - while its Astra line was credited with [breaking a 1941 Enigma message](../summaries/f2f52074f70a.md) that had resisted cryptanalysts since 2005. The day's sharpest story stayed Meta's Muse: Patrick Wardle disclosed a [zero-day in the Muse macOS app](../summaries/16444d7e895b.md) that lets any local app steal the token authenticating a user's account, days after Sensor Tower counted [902K+ downloads in six days](../summaries/9249cb0b81d7.md) and Amazon [blocked Muse from shopping on amazon.com](../summaries/41d477801352.md). The accountability beat turned grimmer when the Pentagon said [overreliance on AI contributed to a missile strike on an Iran school](../summaries/0abe1054a0d1.md). Underneath, the Jev thread kept running - [OpenAI is well positioned to fast-follow](../summaries/ca5a92ed0988.md), with [JevBench](../summaries/0bd216136f9c.md) keeping score - Max Woolf showed agents can [write Rust faster than state-of-the-art](../summaries/6df4f2080d60.md), and the discourse stayed hot: a viral essay told readers to [fear AI companies, not AI](../summaries/d8d2c72cc3e1.md), and Zelda Williams told fans generating AI videos of her father to ['have some shame'](../summaries/40f72ef242d4.md).
